premise: At sunset the day's Butterfly and the night's Firefly meet on Flower's petal, and each tells the other about her time.
inspiration: The folk pairing of the Sun and the Moon, who never meet, turned: they do meet, at sunset, and trade their worlds.
lesson: Friends who are different can share their worlds.

en-US.title: Butterfly Meets Firefly
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} Butterfly loved the daytime: bright colours, warm sun, flowers everywhere. [sighs] But every evening, just as it got lovely and golden, it was time for bed. {canvas:sunset 0.8 32s} One evening, she stayed a little longer, on the edge of Flower's petal {flower:pulse}. And a tiny light blinked on beside her. [gasps] Hello, said the light. It was Firefly! {firefly:fade-in} I'm just waking up. What's the daytime like? Butterfly told her about the sunshine, and the colours, and the bees. [curious] And what's the night like? she asked. {sfx:crickets} Firefly {firefly:glow} told her about the moon, and the stars, and the crickets. [happily] Let's meet here every sunset, said Butterfly. You tell me the night, and I'll tell you the day. And Flower {flower:hearts} kept them a seat, right in the middle.

es-ES.title: Mariposa conoce a Luciérnaga
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} A Mariposa le encantaba el día: colores brillantes, sol calentito, flores por todas partes. [sighs] Pero cada tarde, justo cuando todo se ponía bonito y dorado, llegaba la hora de dormir. {canvas:sunset 0.8 32s} Una tarde, se quedó un poquito más, en el borde de un pétalo de Flor {flower:pulse}. Y a su lado se encendió una lucecita. [gasps] Hola, dijo la luz. ¡Era Luciérnaga! {firefly:fade-in} Me acabo de despertar. ¿Cómo es el día? Mariposa le contó cómo era el sol, y los colores, y las abejas. [curious] ¿Y cómo es la noche?, preguntó. {sfx:crickets} Luciérnaga {firefly:glow} le habló de la luna, y de las estrellas, y de los grillos. [happily] Vamos a vernos aquí cada atardecer, dijo Mariposa. Tú me cuentas la noche, y yo te cuento el día. Y Flor {flower:hearts} les guardó un sitio, justo en el medio.

crickets.prompt: the first soft crickets of a summer evening
